headline: Lagos Showcases Startup Ecosystem and Digital Economy at GITEX Nigeria
summary: The Lagos State Government promoted its tech startup ecosystem and digital economy investment opportunities at the GITEX Nigeria 2026 conference to position the state as an innovation capital.
why: Lagos is West Africa's primary financial and venture technology hub, attracting significant venture capital and international digital infrastructure investment.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: State-led promotion at tech summits aims to stimulate foreign direct investment and venture funding into the local tech sector.
